rows.subtype: Using skills for a purpose beyond self [Actor]
rows.description: A young professional feels both content and restless, uses their skills to teach, build or serve, and sees growth as continuing, not a finish line.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 18–22

rows.description: An adult accepts that growth can begin amid limited means, starts with small acts of learning or creating, and does not treat comfort or wealth as a requirement for it.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 18–22

rows.description: A child pushes an adult's hand away from the shoelaces and insists on tying them alone, taking pride in choosing and doing; the wish for independence grows from here.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.subtype: Wants to choose own subject and friends [Actor]
rows.description: A teenager wants to choose their stream and friends on their own judgment, and clashes with parents' plans; independence feels like part of who they are.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 4–6, 18–22, 23–26

rows.subtype: Forging own path despite family pressure [Actor]
rows.description: A young adult explores an unusual career, accepting risk and disapproval; freedom and curiosity matter more to them than an approved route, though they still love their family.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 4–6, 13–17, 23–26

rows.description: An adult protects their freedom of choice while honouring duties to parents and colleagues, explaining reasons and staying open to others' views rather than simply defying.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 4–6, 13–17, 18–22

rows.subtype: Wants warm, sweet, soft things now [Actor]
rows.description: A toddler seeks sweets, cuddles and bubbles and cries when they stop; seeking pleasure and comfort is a simple, natural drive at this age.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.subtype: Lives for fun and good times [Actor]
rows.description: A teenager plans around films, outings and food, and finds long-term duty dull; the love of enjoyment brings vitality and friends, and can crowd out work if it rules everything.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 18–22, 23–26

rows.subtype: Pleasure versus duty in the hostel [Actor]
rows.description: A young adult skips a study session for a late-night outing and enjoys it fully while feeling a pinch of guilt; enjoyment and responsibility pull in different directions.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 13–17, 23–26

rows.subtype: Savouring without being ruled by it [Response]
rows.description: An adult treats joy as valuable, taking real time for meals, rest and play, and keeps pleasure in balance with health and commitments instead of chasing the next thrill.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 13–17, 18–22
